english.title: Provide false n/a to authorised officer for issue of FPT re abandoning vehicles - Refuse Disposal (Amenity) Act 1978
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) provided false or inaccurate details in response to a requirement for your name and address from an authorised officer of **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL AUTHORITY..) who was proposing to give you a notice under section 2A of the Refuse Disposal (Amenity) Act 1978
